seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, season dates, where to stay and how to get to Ischgl in Tyrol, Austria.

h1: Ischgl ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Ischgl runs 239 kilometres of slopes and snow parks up to 2,872 metres, and its 2026/27 season is published in full: 26 November 2026 to 2 May 2027, one of the longest in the Alps. The ski area crosses the border into Samnaun in Switzerland.

kpis.label: Slopes
kpis.note: Ischgl and Samnaun on one pass

stayOverview: Ischgl itself is where the Silvretta gondola and the nightlife are; Galtür further up the Paznaun is quieter and cheaper; Samnaun is the duty-free Swiss end of the same ski area.
hotelIntro: Book against the published season: 26 November 2026 to 2 May 2027, which is longer than most of the Alps.
rentalCars: Ischgl is at the end of the Paznaun valley; the nearest railway is at Landeck and a car or transfer is the normal way in.
